title: Trial And Error Retextures
description: A resource pack that edits some textures of Create: Trial And Error
body:
**This resoure pack edits textures of Create: Trial And Error while remaining true to the original.**

It affects:

- Blank Slate
- Ominous Blank Slate
- Trial Key Cast
- Ominous Trial Key Cast
- Filled Trial Key Cast
- Filled Ominous Trial Key Cast

It also changes the particles from using the Blank Slate or Ominous Blank Slate to fit the new item textures.
